title: Database Health
description: Pool utilization and query latency. Incident-shape window — DB issues cascade fast.

panels.title: Pool connections in use
panels.description: Currently checked-out asyncpg connections. Approaching db_pool_size + db_max_overflow = saturation.

panels.title: Query rate by type (queries/sec)
panels.description: select / insert / update / delete / other. Sudden imbalance signals a specific code path regressing.

panels.title: p95 query latency by type (seconds)
panels.description: p95 latency per query class. SELECT p95 > 100ms means an index is missing or a join is exploding.

panels.title: Slow queries (>500ms) per minute
panels.description: Rate of queries crossing SLOW_QUERY_THRESHOLD_MS (500ms; see app/core/database.py). Each slow query also fires a structlog warning with the SQL preview — correlate via trace_id.
